scope: Tower visual world readiness. Separates decoded geometry/material ownership, portable visual coverage, instruction-proven material semantics, exact native draw admission, and separate STerrain/natural geometry.

shader_semantic_frontier.note: Materials without direct RGB/BC5 roles are not necessarily unresolved. Many have exact palette, scalar, mask, cubemap, reflection, alpha-test, or other shader-specific semantics that require native shader replay rather than a portable PBR slot.

common_layer.note: Subsequent shader-dataflow work promoted several common families from heuristic preview roles to instruction-proven semantics.

current_live_renderer.source: Rust-test docs/D1_PARITY_STATUS_2026-09-12.md and uregraph runtime dependency contract
current_live_renderer.explanation: Exact SPIR-V/program/runtime binding infrastructure exists, but G-buffer output, fixed-function state, runtime globals/images, deferred lighting and pass composition still gate native draw admission.

terrain.generic_decoder_status: authoritative decoder already proven on Crota STerrain
terrain.tower_status: current-retail exact census launched; Tower-specific occurrence/material counts not yet promoted
terrain.note: Baked static ground/world geometry is already present separately. STerrain/natural geometry outside the baked/static layer is a distinct source layer.

fidelity_blockers_ordered: native G-buffer outputs for broad proven surface shader families
Activity-owned light accumulation and global/runtime producers, especially raw 0x4B channel 0x28 plus Frame+0x1C and DeferredLight+0x100
exact fixed-function state, MRT composition and transparent ordering
Activity probes/cubemaps, lower texture mips and explicit LOD behavior
retail sky, shadows, fog/atmosphere, exposure/tonemapping, bloom/post and VFX
Tower STerrain/natural-geometry integration if the exact census confirms separate terrain resources
proof_boundary: Portable textured coverage is not exact retail-material coverage. Instruction-proven texture roles are not equivalent to complete shader equations. Exact native admission remains zero until the full draw/runtime/pass contract closes.
